scripts.youtube:build: tsc && VITE_STORE=youtube VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= vite build --outDir dist-youtube --emptyOutDir && python3 tools/youtube-bundle.py dist-youtube
scripts.test:fast: vitest run --exclude tests/balance.test.ts --exclude tests/racecraft.test.ts --exclude tests/pits.test.ts --exclude tests/tyres.test.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:play: VITE_STORE=play npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: node tools/ios-version.mjs && npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
